<b>Pilgrim Pouncers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are agile pilgrims with a softer shell than most, their higher functions lost to the [[Haunting]].<ref>Pilgrim Pouncer [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Agile bug of Pharloom, its higher functions have been lost to the Haunting. With a softer shell than most, they would have relied on their athleticism to survive."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Pouncers are usually found slowly walking back and forth or praying in place, but some crawl out of the ground or are reanimated by [[Silk]] when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, ambushing her. When Hornet is near, they leap towards her to attack, then roll a short distance on the ground as they land.<br>
If a Pilgrim Pouncer falls off a ledge whilst rolling, it will roll again as it lands.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Pouncers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Pilgrim Pouncers can be found primarily in [[Mosshome]] and [[the Marrow]], but they also appear in the southeastern [[Far Fields]], the middle of [[Greymoor]], and the [[Blasted Steps]].

In [[Bonegrave]], one Pilgrim Pouncer can appear as a possible enemy spawn variant upon revisiting the area. Inside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]], one is encountered as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Chapel_of_the_Wanderer|gauntlet]]. In the Marrow, once [[Swift Step]] has been acquired, two can be found in the room where [[Shakra]] was previously encountered, and one spawns during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Marrow 2|gauntlet]] in the north of the area. Additionally, a unique Pilgrim Pouncer, [[Haunting|haunted]] [[Pebb]], can be encountered in the easternmost room of the Marrow and does not respawn once defeated. Pebb can be identified by her unique [[Needolin]] dialogue, her merchant bag lying nearby, and {{R|55}} she drops upon defeat.

In the Blasted Steps, one of the lifeless Pilgrim Pouncers awakens shortly after the nearby [[Judge]]. However, if the Judge is awakened by parrying a [[Tool]] attack without taking damage, the pilgrim remains dormant.

During [[Act 3]], two Pilgrim Pouncers can be found in [[Shellwood]] attacking [[Pinmaster Plinney]].
